items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: Well, but he wasn't my first drummer. See, Chinese kept on messing up and I used to have to go like the devil and get somebody, see.

ctx.x: Oh, I didn't know he was downtown.
Yeah, DePaz, Arnal DePaz. Well, but he wasn't my first drummer. See, Chinese kept on messing up and I used to have to go like the devil and get somebody, see.
